subject: Medford High School Building Project
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed School Committee Vice Chair and High School Project Chair Jenny Graham on Medford Happenings regarding the Medford High School building project. Graham outlined the MSBA feasibility process, timeline, project scope, funding considerations, and community engagement efforts.

items.title: Introduction and Guest Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced School Committee Vice Chair and High School Project Chair Jenny Graham, who discussed her personal and professional background.

items.title: High School Project Status and Feasibility Phase
items.summary: Graham explained that the project entered the MSBA feasibility phase following acceptance in December 2023, with the committee currently working to narrow dozens of site options down to three to five before selecting a single option by June.

items.title: Project Scope and Educational Metrics
items.summary: Graham detailed that the facility will house comprehensive and vocational high school programs, Curtis Tufts alternative programming, district pre-K, central administration, and community spaces, while noting that bringing the existing building to code alone would cost $438 million without MSBA reimbursement.

items.title: Project Cost Components and Bonding
items.summary: Graham clarified that initial cost estimates include construction, materials, escalation, contingency, and potential modular spaces, while municipal bond interest and operating budget impacts will be calculated separately.

items.title: MSBA Reimbursement Process
items.summary: Graham explained the statutory formula and incentive point system governing MSBA reimbursement rates and noted that final construction reimbursement shares and local debt exclusion figures will be determined next year.

items.title: Project Management and Design Team
items.summary: Graham noted that LeftField was selected as the owner's project manager and SMMA was chosen by a joint city-MSBA panel as the project designer.

items.title: Design Selection Criteria and Public Engagement
items.summary: Graham described the 25-member committee's review process, ongoing public forums, and the balance of maximizing educational value while managing construction disruption on an occupied campus.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Petrella concluded the interview and shared broadcast, website, and contact information for the program.
